ko: 문 앞에서 인사드리겠습니다 하고 숨을 골랐어요.
de: Vor der Tür sagte ich ich werde mich höflich vorstellen und holte Luft.
en: At the door I said I will greet you respectfully and took a breath.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0100 and satz_a1_0064

ko: 문 앞에서 먼저 인사드렸어요.
de: Vor der Tür habe ich zuerst höflich gegrüßt.
en: I greeted them respectfully at the door first.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0101 and satz_a1_0065

ko: 오늘은 장인어른께 처음 인사드려요.
de: Heute begrüße ich zum ersten Mal meinen Schwiegervater.
en: Today I greet my father-in-law for the first time.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0102 and satz_a1_0066

ko: 장모님, 이 과일 받아 주세요.
de: Frau Schwiegermutter, bitte nehmen Sie dieses Obst.
en: Please take this fruit, eomeonim.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0103 and satz_a1_0067

ko: 시아버지께서 현관에 나오셨어요.
de: Mein Schwiegervater ist in den Flur gekommen.
en: My father-in-law came out to the hallway.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0104 and satz_a1_0068

ko: 시어머니께서 미소를 지으셨어요.
de: Meine Schwiegermutter hat gelächelt.
en: My mother-in-law smiled.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0105 and satz_a1_0069

ko: 호칭이 어려워서 현우에게 물어봤어요.
de: Die Anrede ist schwer, deshalb habe ich Hyunwoo gefragt.
en: The form of address is hard, so I asked Hyunwoo.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0106 and satz_a1_0070

ko: 부모님 앞에서는 높임말을 써요.
de: Vor den Eltern benutze ich die Höflichkeitsform.
en: I use raised speech in front of the parents.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0107 and satz_a1_0071

ko: 성함을 묻기 전에 현우가 눈짓을 했어요.
de: Bevor ich nach dem Namen fragte, gab Hyunwoo ein Zeichen.
en: Before I asked the name politely, Hyunwoo gave a look.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0108 and satz_a1_0072

ko: 나이는 묻지 말고 몇 살이세요는 나중에 들어요.
de: Fragen Sie nicht nach dem Alter; 몇 살이세요 hören Sie später.
en: Do not ask age first; you will hear 몇 살이세요 later.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0109 and satz_a1_0073

ko: 앞으로 잘 부탁드립니다.
de: Bitte sehen Sie es mir nach und nehmen Sie mich auf.
en: Please look after me from now on.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0110 and satz_a1_0074

ko: 댁에 처음 와서 신발이 헷갈려요.
de: Ich bin zum ersten Mal bei Ihnen und verwechsele die Schuhe.
en: It is my first time at your home, so the shoes confuse me.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_meet_names_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0111 and satz_a1_0075

ko: 과일 바구니를 들고 초인종을 눌렀어요.
de: Mit einem Obstkorb habe ich geklingelt.
en: I rang the doorbell holding a fruit basket.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0112 and satz_a1_0076

ko: 건강식품은 너무 약처럼 보일까 봐 고민했어요.
de: Ich überlegte, ob Gesundheitslebensmittel zu sehr nach Medizin aussehen.
en: I wondered whether health food would look too much like medicine.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0113 and satz_a1_0077

ko: 과한 선물은 부담이 된다고 현우가 말했어요.
de: Hyunwoo sagte, ein zu großes Geschenk mache Druck.
en: Hyunwoo said an overly big gift creates pressure.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0114 and satz_a1_0078

ko: 큰돈 말고 작은 정성이면 충분해요.
de: Kein großes Geld, eine kleine Aufmerksamkeit reicht.
en: Not a lot of money; a small token of care is enough.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0115 and satz_a1_0079

ko: 포장이 예쁘면 인사가 쉬워져요.
de: Wenn die Verpackung schön ist, fällt der Gruß leichter.
en: Nice wrapping makes the greeting easier.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0116 and satz_a1_0080

ko: 별건 아니지만 받아 주세요.
de: Es ist nichts Besonderes, aber bitte nehmen Sie es.
en: It is nothing special, but please accept it.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0117 and satz_a1_0081

ko: 처음에는 사양하다가 결국 받으셨어요.
de: Zuerst lehnten sie höflich ab und nahmen es dann doch.
en: They declined politely at first and then accepted.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0118 and satz_a1_0082

ko: 빈손으로 가면 현우가 더 긴장해요.
de: Wenn ich mit leeren Händen komme, ist Hyunwoo noch nervöser.
en: If I arrive empty-handed, Hyunwoo gets even more nervous.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0119 and satz_a1_0083

ko: 백화점 상품권은 실용적이지만 차가워 보일 수 있어요.
de: Ein Kaufhausgutschein ist praktisch, kann aber kühl wirken.
en: A department-store voucher is practical but can feel cold.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0120 and satz_a1_0084

ko: 꽃다발은 예쁘지만 버스에서 힘들어요.
de: Ein Blumenstrauß ist schön, aber im Bus anstrengend.
en: A bouquet is pretty but hard to carry on the bus.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0121 and satz_a1_0085

ko: 돌아갈 때 답례로 반찬을 주셨어요.
de: Beim Gehen gaben sie als Gegengeschenk Beilagen mit.
en: When I left they gave side dishes as a return gift.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0122 and satz_a1_0086

ko: 선물 뒤에 짧은 감사 인사를 꼭 해요.
de: Nach dem Geschenk mache ich unbedingt einen kurzen Dankesgruß.
en: After the gift I always give a short thank-you.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_first_gift_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0123 and satz_a1_0087

ko: 현관에서 신발을 벗고 잠시 멈췄어요.
de: In der Diele zog ich die Schuhe aus und blieb kurz stehen.
en: I took off my shoes in the entryway and paused.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0124 and satz_a1_0088

ko: 손님 슬리퍼가 왼쪽 짝만 남았어요.
de: Von den Gästeslippern war nur der linke übrig.
en: Only the left guest slipper was left.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0125 and satz_a1_0089

ko: 앉으세요 하셨는데 어디가 제 자리인지 몰랐어요.
de: Sie sagten setzen Sie sich bitte, aber ich wusste nicht, welcher Platz meiner ist.
en: They said please sit, but I did not know which seat was mine.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0126 and satz_a1_0090

ko: 윗목은 어른 자리라서 현우가 눈을 깜빡였어요.
de: Der innere Sitzplatz ist für Ältere, deshalb blinzelte Hyunwoo.
en: The inner seat is for elders, so Hyunwoo blinked at me.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0127 and satz_a1_0091

ko: 저는 아랫목에 앉는 게 안전해요.
de: Für mich ist der Platz näher zur Tür sicherer.
en: The seat nearer the door is safer for me.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0128 and satz_a1_0092

ko: 바닥에 앉으니 무릎이 먼저 아팠어요.
de: Als ich auf dem Boden saß, taten zuerst die Knie weh.
en: When I sat on the floor, my knees hurt first.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0129 and satz_a1_0093

ko: 방석을 밀어 주시는데 감사하다고 했어요.
de: Sie schoben mir ein Sitzkissen hin, und ich sagte danke.
en: They slid a floor cushion over, and I said thank you.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0130 and satz_a1_0094

ko: 물 드세요 하시자마자 컵을 두 손으로 받았어요.
de: Kaum sagten sie trinken Sie etwas, nahm ich die Tasse mit beiden Händen.
en: As soon as they said please have water, I took the cup with both hands.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0131 and satz_a1_0095

ko: 밥 전에 손 씻기 화장실이 어디인지 물었어요.
de: Vor dem Essen fragte ich, wo man sich die Hände wäscht.
en: Before the meal I asked where to wash my hands.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0132 and satz_a1_0096

ko: 화장실 문을 열고 손님 슬리퍼를 또 찾았어요.
de: Ich öffnete die Toilettentür und suchte wieder nach Gästeslippern.
en: I opened the bathroom door and looked for guest slippers again.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0133 and satz_a1_0097

ko: 할아버지가 주무셔서 조용히 했어요.
de: Der Großvater schlief, deshalb war ich leise.
en: Grandfather was sleeping, so I kept quiet.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0134 and satz_a1_0098

ko: 집들이 예절은 현우가 차에 타기 전에 알려 줬어요.
de: Die Besuchsmanieren erklärte Hyunwoo noch vor der Autofahrt.
en: Hyunwoo explained house-visit manners before we got in the car.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_house_entry_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0135 and satz_a1_0099

ko: 진지 드세요 하니까 숟가락을 집었어요.
de: Als sie die ehrenvolle Mahlzeit anboten, nahm ich den Löffel.
en: When they offered the meal, I picked up the spoon.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0136 and satz_a1_0100

ko: 수저가 두 벌이라 어느 게 제 것인지 봤어요.
de: Es gab zwei Garnituren Löffel und Stäbchen, also schaute ich, welche meine sind.
en: There were two sets of spoon and chopsticks, so I checked which were mine.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0137 and satz_a1_0101

ko: 밑반찬이 열 가지라서 눈이 커졌어요.
de: Es gab zehn Grundbeilagen, da wurden meine Augen groß.
en: There were ten basic side dishes, so my eyes got wide.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0138 and satz_a1_0102

ko: 더 드세요를 세 번 듣고 수저를 다시 들었어요.
de: Nach dreimal essen Sie noch mehr hob ich die Stäbchen wieder.
en: After hearing please eat more three times, I picked up the utensils again.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0139 and satz_a1_0103

ko: 배불러요라고 했는데도 과일이 나왔어요.
de: Ich sagte ich bin satt, und trotzdem kam Obst.
en: I said I am full, and fruit still came out.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0140 and satz_a1_0104

ko: 맛있어요를 매 접시마다 말하니 현우가 웃었어요.
de: Bei jedem Teller sagte ich, dass es schmeckt, und Hyunwoo hat gelacht.
en: I kept saying it was tasty, and Hyunwoo laughed.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0141 and satz_a1_0105

ko: 집밥이 식당보다 반찬이 많아요.
de: Hausmannskost hat mehr Beilagen als ein Restaurant.
en: Home cooking has more side dishes than a restaurant.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0142 and satz_a1_0106

ko: 국물을 소리 없이 떠먹으려고 집중했어요.
de: Ich konzentrierte mich, die Brühe ohne Geräusch zu löffeln.
en: I focused on spooning the broth without noise.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0143 and satz_a1_0107

ko: 젓가락질이 흔들려서 콩나물을 놓쳤어요.
de: Meine Stäbchenhaltung wackelte, und ich verlor die Sojasprossen.
en: My chopstick grip wobbled, and I dropped the bean sprouts.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0144 and satz_a1_0108

ko: 앞접시에 먼저 조금 덜었어요.
de: Auf den kleinen Essteller habe ich zuerst etwas genommen.
en: I put a little on the individual plate first.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0145 and satz_a1_0109

ko: 이야기를 들을 때는 수저 놓고 고개를 끄덕였어요.
de: Beim Zuhören legte ich das Besteck hin und nickte.
en: While listening I put the utensils down and nodded.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0146 and satz_a1_0110

ko: 설거지를 돕겠다고 일어섰더니 앉으라고 하셨어요.
de: Ich stand auf, um beim Abwasch zu helfen, und sollte wieder sitzen.
en: I stood up to help with dishes and was told to sit back down.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_table_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0147 and satz_a1_0111

ko: 설날 아침에 한복을 빌려 입었어요.
de: Am Seollal-Morgen habe ich Hanbok ausgeliehen.
en: On Seollal morning I borrowed a hanbok.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0148 and satz_a1_0112

ko: 세배 각도를 현우가 거실에서 연습시켜 줬어요.
de: Hyunwoo hat den Winkel der Neujahrsverbeugung im Wohnzimmer geübt.
en: Hyunwoo had me practice the New Year bow in the living room.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0149 and satz_a1_0113

ko: 떡국 한 그릇을 비우니 나이 농담이 나왔어요.
de: Nach einer Schüssel Reiskuchen-Suppe kamen Scherze über das Alter.
en: After one bowl of rice-cake soup, age jokes started.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0150 and satz_a1_0114

ko: 세뱃돈을 받으니 얼굴이 빨개졌어요.
de: Als ich Neujahrsgeld bekam, wurde ich rot.
en: I blushed when I received New Year money.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0151 and satz_a1_0115

ko: 한복 고름을 앞에서 매다가 현우 엄마가 도와주셨어요.
de: Als ich die Hanbok-Schleife vorne band, half Hyunwoos Mutter.
en: Hyunwoo's mom helped when I tied the hanbok ribbon in front.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0152 and satz_a1_0116

ko: 새해 복 많이 받으세요를 세 번 연습하고 들어갔어요.
de: Ich übte ein gesegnetes neues Jahr dreimal und ging hinein.
en: I practiced happy new year three times and then went in.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0153 and satz_a1_0117

ko: 절하는 타이밍을 놓쳐서 한 박자 늦게 했어요.
de: Ich verpasste den Moment zum Verbeugen und war einen Schlag zu spät.
en: I missed the bow timing and was one beat late.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0154 and satz_a1_0118

ko: 어른께 세배 드리고 일어나니 무릎이 하얘졌어요.
de: Nach der Verbeugung vor den Älteren wurden meine Knie weiß.
en: After offering the New Year bow, my knees went white.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0155 and satz_a1_0119

ko: 덕담을 들으니 독일어로 뭐라고 할지 생각이 멈췄어요.
de: Beim Neujahrswunsch blieb mein Deutsch stehen.
en: When I heard the well-wish, my German froze.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0156 and satz_a1_0120

ko: 차례상 앞에서는 사진을 찍지 말라고 했어요.
de: Vor dem Ahnenopfer-Tisch sollte ich nicht fotografieren.
en: They told me not to take photos in front of the rite table.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0157 and satz_a1_0121

ko: 세배함이 얇아서 두 손으로 더 조심히 받았어요.
de: Der Umschlag war dünn, also nahm ich ihn noch vorsichtiger mit beiden Händen.
en: The envelope was thin, so I received it even more carefully with both hands.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0158 and satz_a1_0122

ko: 설빔으로 한복 대신 단정한 니트를 골랐어요.
de: Als Neujahrskleidung wählte ich statt Hanbok einen schlichten Pullover.
en: For New Year clothes I chose a neat sweater instead of hanbok.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_seollal_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0159 and satz_a1_0123

ko: 추석에는 고속도로가 주차장이에요.
de: An Chuseok ist die Autobahn ein Parkplatz.
en: At Chuseok the highway is a parking lot.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_chuseok_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0160 and satz_a1_0124

ko: 송편 속이 달아서 하나만 더 집었어요.
de: Die Füllung der Songpyeon war süß, also nahm ich noch eines.
en: The songpyeon filling was sweet, so I took one more.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_chuseok_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0161 and satz_a1_0125

ko: 송편 빚다가 만두처럼 커졌어요.
de: Beim Formen wurden sie so groß wie Teigtaschen.
en: While shaping songpyeon they grew as big as dumplings.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_chuseok_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0162 and satz_a1_0126

ko: 귀성 기차를 예매하려고 알람을 다섯 개 맞췄어요.
de: Für die Heimfahrt stellte ich fünf Wecker, um Tickets zu kaufen.
en: I set five alarms to book the holiday train home.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_chuseok_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0163 and satz_a1_0127

ko: 성묘 갈 때 편한 신발을 신으라고 했어요.
de: Zum Grabbesuch sollte ich bequeme Schuhe anziehen.
en: They told me to wear comfortable shoes for the grave visit.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_chuseok_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0164 and satz_a1_0128

ko: 벌초는 산에 올라가서 풀을 깎는 일이에요.
de: Grabpflege heißt, den Berg hinaufzusteigen und Gras zu schneiden.
en: Tending the grave means climbing the hill and cutting grass.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: a1_partner_chuseok_basic_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a1_0165 and satz_a1_0129

field_notes: rights: original; pack: a2_partner_sibling_tease_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a2_0120 and satz_a2_0083

field_notes: rights: original; pack: a2_partner_sibling_tease_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a2_0121 and satz_a2_0084

field_notes: rights: original; pack: a2_partner_overnight_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_a2_0135 and satz_a2_0098

field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_honorific_trap_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0200 and satz_b2_0186

ko: 호칭 질문을 먼저 하니 긴장이 풀렸어요.
de: Die Anredefrage zuerst zu stellen löste die Anspannung.
en: Asking the address-term question first eased the tension.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_honorific_trap_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0201 and satz_b2_0187

ko: 잘못된 형이라고 부르는 순간 현우 얼굴이 멈췄어요.
de: Im Moment des falschen hyeong blieb Hyunwoos Gesicht stehen.
en: The moment I used the wrong hyeong, Hyunwoo's face froze.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_honorific_trap_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0202 and satz_b2_0188

ko: 호칭 메모를 주머니에 넣고 화장실에서 봤어요.
de: Die Anredenotiz lag in der Tasche, ich las sie auf der Toilette.
en: I kept an address-term note in my pocket and checked it in the bathroom.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_honorific_trap_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0203 and satz_b2_0189

ko: 헷갈리면 다시 여쭤보는 게 침묵보다 나았어요.
de: Bei Zweifel noch einmal höflich zu fragen war besser als Schweigen.
en: When unsure, asking again politely was better than silence.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_honorific_trap_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0204 and satz_b2_0190

ko: 호칭을 미루고 성함만 쓰니 갈등이 없었어요.
de: Die Anrede aufzuschieben und nur den Namen zu nutzen vermied Konflikt.
en: Postponing the address and using the name avoided conflict.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_honorific_trap_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0205 and satz_b2_0191

ko: 제사상 앞에서는 발을 모으고 서 있었어요.
de: Vor dem Ahnentisch stand ich mit geschlossenen Füßen.
en: In front of the offering table I stood with my feet together.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0206 and satz_b2_0192

ko: 지방 쓰기는 제가 하지 않고 옆에서 종이만 잡았어요.
de: Den Ahnenzettel schrieb ich nicht, ich hielt nur das Papier.
en: I did not write the name paper; I only held the sheet.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0207 and satz_b2_0193

ko: 술잔 올리기 순서를 놓쳐서 한 박자 늦게 했어요.
de: Die Reihenfolge beim Darbringen verpasste ich um einen Schlag.
en: I missed the wine-cup offering order and was one beat late.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0208 and satz_b2_0194

ko: 재배 각도를 현우가 거실에서 다시 보여 줬어요.
de: Den Winkel der doppelten Verbeugung zeigte Hyunwoo noch einmal im Wohnzimmer.
en: Hyunwoo showed me the double bow again in the living room.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0209 and satz_b2_0195

ko: 축문은 듣지 못해도 고개를 숙이면 됐어요.
de: Den Ritualtext verstand ich nicht, Senken des Kopfes reichte.
en: I could not follow the prayer text; lowering my head was enough.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0210 and satz_b2_0196

ko: 음복 전에는 음식을 집지 말라고 했어요.
de: Vor dem Mitessen nach dem Ritual sollte ich nichts nehmen.
en: They told me not to take food before the after-rite meal.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0211 and satz_b2_0197

ko: 사진 예절은 상 옆이 아니라 끝난 뒤에만이었어요.
de: Fotomanieren hieß: nicht neben dem Tisch, erst danach.
en: Photo manners meant not beside the table, only after.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0212 and satz_b2_0198

ko: 제사 역할이 없으면 조용히 서는 게 도움이었어요.
de: Ohne Ritualaufgabe half ruhiges Stehen.
en: With no rite role, standing quietly helped.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0213 and satz_b2_0199

ko: 차례 순서를 종이에 적어 주머니에 넣었어요.
de: Den Ablauf schrieb ich auf Papier und steckte ihn ein.
en: I wrote the rite order on paper and put it in my pocket.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0214 and satz_b2_0200

ko: 조상님께 인사한다는 설명을 듣고 마음이 차분해졌어요.
de: Die Erklärung, den Vorfahren zu grüßen, beruhigte mich.
en: Hearing that we greet the ancestors calmed me.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0215 and satz_b2_0201

ko: 제사 음식 배치를 건드리지 말라고 눈짓하셨어요.
de: Die Anordnung der Ritualspeisen nicht zu berühren zeigte ein Blick.
en: A look said not to touch the arrangement of rite food.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0216 and satz_b2_0202

ko: 뜻을 몰라도 예를 갖추면 자리를 지킬 수 있었어요.
de: Auch ohne den Sinn zu kennen wahrte die Form meinen Platz.
en: Even without knowing the meaning, keeping form held my place.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_ancestral_rite_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0217 and satz_b2_0203

ko: 명절에 용돈 드리는 봉투를 현우가 미리 준비했어요.
de: Den Umschlag für Taschengeld an die Älteren bereitete Hyunwoo vorher vor.
en: Hyunwoo prepared the pocket-money envelope for the elders in advance.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0218 and satz_b2_0204

ko: 더치페이 오해가 나와서 제가 밥값을 먼저 냈어요.
de: Ein Missverständnis um Getrenntzahlen entstand, also zahlte ich zuerst.
en: A split-bill misunderstanding appeared, so I paid for the meal first.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0219 and satz_b2_0205

ko: 축의금 액수를 공개 자리에서 묻지 않기로 했어요.
de: Die Höhe des Glücksgeldes nicht öffentlich zu fragen vereinbarten wir.
en: We agreed not to ask the wedding-money amount in public.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0220 and satz_b2_0206

ko: 부조 장부를 보고 액수를 맞추려다 현우가 말렸어요.
de: Im Beistandsbuch die Summe anzugleichen hinderte Hyunwoo.
en: Hyunwoo stopped me from matching the amount in the aid ledger.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0221 and satz_b2_0207

ko: 생활비 분담은 가족 앞에서 자세히 말하지 않았어요.
de: Die Teilung der Lebenshaltungskosten erklärte ich vor der Familie nicht im Detail.
en: I did not explain sharing living costs in detail in front of the family.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0222 and satz_b2_0208

ko: 빚 이야기는 식탁이 아니라 나중에 둘이 하기로 했어요.
de: Schuldenrede gehörte nicht an den Tisch, sondern später zu uns beiden.
en: Talk about debt was for later between us, not at the table.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0223 and satz_b2_0209

ko: 집 장만 질문을 범위만 말하고 숫자를 피했어요.
de: Die Wohnungskauffrage beantwortete ich mit einem Rahmen, ohne Zahlen.
en: I answered the home-buying question with a range and avoided numbers.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0224 and satz_b2_0210

ko: 부모님 지원 여부는 감사만 하고 액수는 숨겼어요.
de: Ob die Eltern unterstützen, dankte ich, die Summe blieb privat.
en: On parental support I only gave thanks and hid the amount.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0225 and satz_b2_0211

ko: 돈 농담이 날카로워서 웃지 않고 물로 넘겼어요.
de: Der Geldscherz war scharf, ich lachte nicht und trank Wasser.
en: The money joke was sharp, so I did not laugh and drank water.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0226 and satz_b2_0212

ko: 각자 계산은 가족 식사에서 서운해 보일 수 있어요.
de: Getrennt zahlen kann bei einem Familienessen gekränkt wirken.
en: Each paying their share can look cold at a family meal.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0227 and satz_b2_0213

ko: 봉투 준비를 빠뜨릴 뻔해서 편의점에서 샀어요.
de: Die Umschlagvorbereitung hätte ich fast vergessen und kaufte einen im Laden.
en: I almost forgot preparing an envelope and bought one at a convenience store.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0228 and satz_b2_0214

ko: 액수는 비밀이라고 하니 더 묻지 않으셨어요.
de: Die Summe bleibt privat stoppte weitere Fragen.
en: Saying the amount stays private stopped further questions.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_family_money_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0229 and satz_b2_0215

ko: 전 부침을 도우려다 기름이 손목에 튀었어요.
de: Beim Braten der Pfannengerichte spritzte Öl aufs Handgelenk.
en: While helping fry pancakes, oil splashed on my wrist.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0230 and satz_b2_0216

ko: 설거지 교대를 제안하니 이모가 놀라셨어요.
de: Einen Abwaschwechsel vorzuschlagen überraschte die Tante.
en: Suggesting a dish-washing rotation surprised aunt.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0231 and satz_b2_0217

ko: 남자는 안 한다는 말을 듣고 현우가 일부러 일어났어요.
de: Männer machen das nicht hörte Hyunwoo und stand absichtlich auf.
en: Hearing men do not do that, Hyunwoo stood up on purpose.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0232 and satz_b2_0218

ko: 명절 노동이 한쪽에만 몰려 있어서 표를 그려 봤어요.
de: Die Feiertagsarbeit lastete auf einer Seite, also zeichnete ich eine Tabelle.
en: Holiday housework sat on one side, so I drew a chart.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0233 and satz_b2_0219

ko: 손님 대접은 웃는 일만이 아니라 물컵을 채우는 일이었어요.
de: Gästebewirtung war nicht nur Lächeln, sondern Gläser nachzufüllen.
en: Hosting guests was not only smiling but refilling water.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0234 and satz_b2_0220

ko: 휴식 교대를 말하니 처음엔 어색했지만 효과가 있었어요.
de: Den Pausenwechsel anzusprechen war erst ungewohnt, wirkte dann.
en: Mentioning a rest rotation felt awkward at first, then worked.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0235 and satz_b2_0221

ko: 음식 나르기를 제가 맡으니 허리가 먼저 아팠어요.
de: Speisen zu tragen übernahm ich, und zuerst tat der Rücken weh.
en: I took on carrying dishes, and my back hurt first.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0236 and satz_b2_0222

ko: 아이 돌보기를 자처하니 형제들이 고마워했어요.
de: Kinderhüten anzubieten dankten die Geschwister.
en: Offering to watch the children made the siblings grateful.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0237 and satz_b2_0223

ko: 불공평을 바로 지적하지 않고 다음 할 일을 나눴어요.
de: Die Ungerechtigkeit nannte ich nicht sofort, wir teilten die nächste Aufgabe.
en: I did not name the unfairness at once; we split the next task.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0238 and satz_b2_0224

ko: 도와드리겠습니다를 큰 소리로 하니 자리가 열렸어요.
de: Ich werde helfen laut zu sagen öffnete einen Platz.
en: Saying I will help out loud opened a place.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0239 and satz_b2_0225

ko: 앉아서 기다리기만 하니 현우 얼굴이 굳었어요.
de: Nur sitzend zu warten ließ Hyunwoos Gesicht fest werden.
en: Only sitting and waiting made Hyunwoo's face tighten.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0240 and satz_b2_0226

ko: 노동을 나누자고 하니 처음엔 웃음이 나왔어요.
de: Die Arbeit zu teilen vorschlagen löste zuerst Lachen aus.
en: Suggesting we share the labor first brought a laugh.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_holiday_duty_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0241 and satz_b2_0227

ko: 선을 긋되 감사는 남기려고 문장을 두 개로 나눴어요.
de: Eine Grenze zu ziehen und trotzdem zu danken hieß, zwei Sätze zu machen.
en: To draw a line and still keep thanks, I split it into two sentences.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0242 and satz_b2_0228

ko: 사생활 질문은 웃으며 다음에 말하겠다고 했어요.
de: Fragen zur Privatsphäre beantwortete ich lächelnd mit später.
en: I smiled at privacy questions and said I would tell later.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0243 and satz_b2_0229

ko: 연락 빈도를 주 일 회로 정하니 부담이 줄었어요.
de: Die Kontakthäufigkeit auf einmal pro Woche zu setzen senkte den Druck.
en: Setting contact to once a week reduced the pressure.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0244 and satz_b2_0230

ko: 거절 문장을 미리 외워 두니 목소리가 흔들리지 않았어요.
de: Einen Absagesatz auswendig zu können hielt die Stimme ruhig.
en: Memorizing a refusal sentence kept my voice steady.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0245 and satz_b2_0231

ko: 타협안을 먼저 내니 거절이 덜 차갑게 들렸어요.
de: Einen Kompromiss zuerst anzubieten machte das Nein weniger kalt.
en: Offering a compromise first made the no sound less cold.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0246 and satz_b2_0232

ko: 감정 노동이 몰릴 때는 현우와 교대하기로 했어요.
de: Wenn die Gefühlsarbeit sich staute, wechselten Hyunwoo und ich uns ab.
en: When emotional labor piled up, Hyunwoo and I took turns.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0247 and satz_b2_0233

ko: 가족 기대를 전부 맞출 수는 없다고 둘이 먼저 합의했어요.
de: Nicht jede Familienerwartung erfüllen zu können vereinbarten wir zuerst.
en: We first agreed we cannot meet every family expectation.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0248 and satz_b2_0234

ko: 정중한 거리를 유지하니 관계가 오히려 오래 갔어요.
de: Höfliche Distanz zu halten machte die Beziehung länger tragfähig.
en: Keeping polite distance made the relationship last better.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0249 and satz_b2_0235

ko: 반복 요구에는 같은 답을 같은 톤으로 했어요.
de: Auf die wiederholte Bitte gab ich dieselbe Antwort im selben Ton.
en: To a repeated demand I gave the same answer in the same tone.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0250 and satz_b2_0236

ko: 우리가 결정할게요를 두 번 말하니 압박이 줄었어요.
de: Wir werden entscheiden zweimal zu sagen senkte den Druck.
en: Saying we will decide twice reduced the pressure.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0251 and satz_b2_0237

ko: 오늘은 여기까지라고 하니 현우가 바로 일어났어요.
de: Für heute reicht es sagte ich, und Hyunwoo stand sofort auf.
en: When I said that is enough for today, Hyunwoo stood up at once.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0252 and satz_b2_0238

ko: 선을 그어도 관계를 지키려고 감사 인사를 남겼어요.
de: Trotz Grenze ließ ich den Dank, um die Beziehung zu wahren.
en: Even after the line I left thanks to keep the relationship.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_boundary_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0253 and satz_b2_0239

ko: 공식 소개에서는 이름보다 관계를 먼저 말했어요.
de: In der formellen Vorstellung nannte ich zuerst die Beziehung, dann den Namen.
en: In the formal introduction I named the relationship before the name.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0254 and satz_b2_0240

ko: 자리 배치는 나이 순이라 제가 문을 가까운 쪽에 앉았어요.
de: Die öffentliche Sitzordnung folgte dem Alter, ich saß nah an der Tür.
en: Public seating followed age, so I sat nearer the door.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0255 and satz_b2_0241

ko: 사진 공개 전에 얼굴이 나온 분들께 확인했어요.
de: Vor der Fotoeröffentlichung fragte ich alle sichtbaren Gesichter.
en: Before posting a photo publicly I checked with every visible face.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0256 and satz_b2_0242

ko: 호칭 공개는 집 안 말과 다르게 더 높였어요.
de: Die öffentliche Anrede war höher als zu Hause.
en: The public form of address was higher than at home.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0257 and satz_b2_0243

ko: 모임 지각을 사과할 때 변명보다 감사를 먼저 했어요.
de: Beim Zuspätkommen dankte ich zuerst statt zu erklären.
en: When late to the gathering I thanked first instead of explaining.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0258 and satz_b2_0244

ko: 단체 인사는 큰 소리보다 고개가 중요했어요.
de: Beim Gruppengruss zählte die Verbeugung mehr als die Lautstärke.
en: In the group greeting the bow mattered more than volume.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0259 and satz_b2_0245

ko: 자리 양보를 하자 삼촌이 괜찮다고 손짓하셨어요.
de: Den Platz abzutreten winkte der Onkel als unnötig ab.
en: When I gave up a seat, uncle gestured that it was fine.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0260 and satz_b2_0246

ko: 공개 질문에는 짧은 답만 하고 자세한 건 나중에 했어요.
de: Auf öffentliche Fragen gab ich kurze Antworten, Details später.
en: To a question in public I gave a short answer and left details for later.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0261 and satz_b2_0247

ko: 커플 호칭을 밖에서 낮추지 않기로 했어요.
de: Die Paaranrede in der Öffentlichkeit nicht zu senken vereinbarten wir.
en: We agreed not to drop couple address terms in public.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0262 and satz_b2_0248

ko: 사람이 많을 때는 소개를 미루는 게 실수가 적었어요.
de: Bei vielen Leuten die Vorstellung zu verschieben vermied Fehler.
en: With many people, delaying the introduction caused fewer slips.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0263 and satz_b2_0249

ko: 관계부터 말하니 악수 타이밍이 맞았어요.
de: Zuerst die Beziehung zu nennen traf den Moment zum Handschlag.
en: Naming the relationship first hit the handshake timing.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0264 and satz_b2_0250

ko: 밖에서 예의를 지키니 집 안 실수는 잊히는 편이었어요.
de: In der Öffentlichkeit die Form zu wahren ließ Fehler zu Hause eher vergessen.
en: Keeping form in public made indoor slips easier to forget.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: b2_partner_public_intro_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_b2_0265 and satz_b2_0251

ko: 우리 며느리라는 말은 환영처럼 들려도 역할을 씌웠어요.
de: Unsere Schwiegertochter klang wie Willkommen und legte doch eine Rolle auf.
en: Our daughter-in-law sounded like welcome and still assigned a role.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0053 and satz_c1_0055

ko: 손님으로 두면 편하지만 소속에서 밀려난 느낌이 났어요.
de: Als Gast belassen zu werden war bequem und schloss zugleich aus.
en: Being left as a guest was comfortable and also felt excluded.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0054 and satz_c1_0056

ko: 소속 프레임을 누가 말하느냐에 따라 자리가 달라졌어요.
de: Wer den Zugehörigkeitsrahmen setzte, verschob meinen Platz.
en: Who set the belonging frame changed my seat.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0055 and satz_c1_0057

ko: 역할 언어를 들을 때마다 현우와 나중에 번역하기로 했어요.
de: Rollensprache später mit Hyunwoo zu übersetzen vereinbarten wir.
en: We agreed to translate role language with Hyunwoo later.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0056 and satz_c1_0058

ko: 포용적 호칭을 제안하니 처음엔 어색했지만 공기가 바뀌었어요.
de: Eine inklusive Anrede vorzuschlagen war erst ungewohnt und änderte dann die Luft.
en: Proposing an inclusive address felt awkward at first and then changed the air.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0057 and satz_c1_0059

ko: 타자화가 웃음을 타고 와서 바로 지적하기 어려웠어요.
de: Othering kam auf einem Lachen und war schwer sofort zu benennen.
en: Othering arrived on a laugh and was hard to name at once.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0058 and satz_c1_0060

ko: 가족 서사에 제가 갑자기 주인공이 되어 부담됐어요.
de: In der Familienerzählung plötzlich Hauptfigur zu sein druckte.
en: Suddenly becoming the lead in the family narrative felt heavy.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0059 and satz_c1_0061

ko: 해석의 주체가 누구인지 묻자 잠시 조용해졌어요.
de: Die Frage, wer deutet, machte einen kurzen Stillstand.
en: Asking who gets to interpret made a short silence.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0060 and satz_c1_0062

ko: 말의 자리가 의자보다 먼저 배치된다는 걸 그날 배웠어요.
de: Dass der Platz der Worte vor dem Stuhl kommt, lernte ich an dem Tag.
en: That day I learned the seat that words give is set before the chair.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0061 and satz_c1_0063

ko: 우리 편이 아니라 같이 온 사람이라고 다시 명명해 달라고 했어요.
de: Nicht unsere Seite, sondern die mitgekommene Person neu zu benennen bat ich.
en: I asked them to rename me not as our side but as the person who came along.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0062 and satz_c1_0064

ko: 프레임을 드러내니 비난이 아니라 설명이 됐어요.
de: Den Rahmen sichtbar zu machen wurde Erklärung, nicht Anklage.
en: Making the frame visible became explanation, not blame.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0063 and satz_c1_0065

ko: 자리를 재협상하자 다음 명절 표가 달라졌어요.
de: Den Platz neu zu verhandeln änderte den Plan für das nächste Fest.
en: Renegotiating my place changed the chart for the next holiday.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_family_framing_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0064 and satz_c1_0066

ko: 보이지 않는 일이 상을 완성한다는 걸 설거지통에서 봤어요.
de: Dass unsichtbare Arbeit den Tisch vollendet, sah ich an der Spüle.
en: I saw at the sink that invisible work finishes the table.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0065 and satz_c1_0067

ko: 성별 분업을 전통으로만 설명하면 대화가 멈췄어요.
de: Die geschlechtliche Arbeitsteilung nur als Tradition zu erklären stoppte das Gespräch.
en: Explaining the gendered division of labor as only tradition stopped talk.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0066 and satz_c1_0068

ko: 돌봄 부담이 한 사람에게 몰리면 웃음의 질이 달라졌어요.
de: Konzentrierte sich die Fürsorgelast auf eine Person, änderte sich das Lachen.
en: When the care burden sat on one person, the quality of laughter changed.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0067 and satz_c1_0069

ko: 기여의 가시성을 사진이 아니라 교대표로 남기기로 했어요.
de: Die Sichtbarkeit des Beitrags hielten wir in einem Wechselplan fest, nicht im Foto.
en: We recorded visibility of contribution on a rotation chart, not in photos.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0068 and satz_c1_0070

ko: 전통의 선택을 모두 지킬 필요는 없다고 짧게 말했어요.
de: Nicht jede Auswahl in der Tradition sei Pflicht, sagte ich kurz.
en: I said briefly that we do not have to keep every piece of tradition.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0069 and satz_c1_0071

ko: 노동 인정은 칭찬 한 마디보다 다음 할 일을 나누는 것이었어요.
de: Anerkennung der Arbeit war weniger ein Lob als das Teilen der nächsten Aufgabe.
en: Recognition of labor was sharing the next task more than one compliment.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0070 and satz_c1_0072

ko: 휴식권을 말하니 처음엔 예의가 아니라는 눈이 왔어요.
de: Das Recht auf Pause anzusprechen brachte zuerst Blicke, das sei ungehörig.
en: Naming a right to rest first brought looks that it was improper.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0071 and satz_c1_0073

ko: 분배 기준을 나이에서 체력으로 바꾸자 반발이 줄었어요.
de: Den Verteilungsmaßstab vom Alter auf Kraft zu ändern senkte den Widerstand.
en: Changing the sharing standard from age to stamina reduced pushback.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0072 and satz_c1_0074

ko: 침묵의 동의를 합의로 보지 않기로 둘이 정했어요.
de: Zustimmung durch Schweigen nicht als Einigung zu lesen beschlossen wir.
en: We decided not to read consent by silence as agreement.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0073 and satz_c1_0075

ko: 한 사람의 성품이 아니라 구조를 바꾸자고 했어요.
de: Nicht den Charakter einer Person, die Struktur ändern, schlug ich vor.
en: I proposed changing the structure, not one person's character.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0074 and satz_c1_0076

ko: 노동을 보이게 하자 감사의 대상이 달라졌어요.
de: Arbeit sichtbar zu machen verschob, wem gedankt wurde.
en: Making labor visible changed who received thanks.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0075 and satz_c1_0077

ko: 공평을 설계하니 감정이 아니라 표가 남았어요.
de: Fairness zu entwerfen ließ eine Tabelle statt nur Gefühle.
en: Designing fairness left a chart, not only feelings.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c1_partner_holiday_labor_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c1_0076 and satz_c1_0078

ko: 의사결정권이 어디에 있는지 묻자 웃음이 먼저 나왔어요.
de: Wo das Entscheidungsrecht liege, zu fragen löste zuerst Lachen aus.
en: Asking where decision rights sit first produced a laugh.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0053 and satz_c2_0055

ko: 침묵 압력은 거절보다 오래 남아서 기록을 남겼어요.
de: Druck durch Schweigen blieb länger als ein Nein, also schrieb ich ihn auf.
en: Pressure through silence lasted longer than a no, so I recorded it.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0054 and satz_c2_0056

ko: 대리 발화가 제 뜻을 바꾸길래 한 문장을 다시 말했어요.
de: Das Sprechen an meiner Stelle änderte meinen Sinn, also wiederholte ich einen Satz.
en: Speaking on my behalf changed my meaning, so I said one sentence again.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0055 and satz_c2_0057

ko: 체면 경제에서는 사실이 아니라 체면이 예산을 정했어요.
de: In der Gesichtsökonomie setzte das Gesicht das Budget, nicht die Tatsache.
en: In the economy of face, face set the budget, not the fact.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0056 and satz_c2_0058

ko: 순응 연출을 기대하는 자리에선 침묵이 칭찬이 됐어요.
de: Wo man Inszenierung von Fügsamkeit erwartete, wurde Schweigen Lob.
en: Where a performance of compliance was expected, silence became praise.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0057 and satz_c2_0059

ko: 권한의 출처를 혈연으로만 두면 외부인은 영원히 손님이에요.
de: Liegt die Quelle der Befugnis nur in der Blutsbindung, bleibt die Außenstehende Gast.
en: If the source of authority is only blood, an outsider stays a guest forever.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0058 and satz_c2_0060

ko: 말의 위계를 깨지 않고도 질문을 하나 넣을 자리는 있었어요.
de: Ohne die Hierarchie der Rede zu zerbrechen gab es Raum für eine Frage.
en: Without breaking the hierarchy of speech there was still room for one question.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0059 and satz_c2_0061

ko: 동의의 형식이 고개인지 서명인지 먼저 정해야 했어요.
de: Ob die Form der Zustimmung ein Nicken oder eine Unterschrift ist, mussten wir klären.
en: We had to decide whether the form of consent is a nod or a signature.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0060 and satz_c2_0062

ko: 불복의 비용을 계산하니 그날은 기록만 남기기로 했어요.
de: Den Preis des Widerspruchs zu rechnen hieß, an dem Tag nur aufzuschreiben.
en: Calculating the cost of dissent meant only recording that day.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0061 and satz_c2_0063

ko: 권력을 호명하니 방이 잠시 조용해졌다가 다시 숨이 돌아왔어요.
de: Macht beim Namen zu nennen machte die Raumstille kurz, dann kam der Atem zurück.
en: Naming the power quieted the room, then breath returned.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0062 and satz_c2_0064

ko: 기분이 아니라 절차를 요구하니 다음 결정이 투명해졌어요.
de: Nicht Stimmung, ein Verfahren zu verlangen machte die nächste Entscheidung klarer.
en: Demanding a procedure, not a mood, made the next decision clearer.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0063 and satz_c2_0065

ko: 자리를 문서화하자 기억 싸움이 줄었어요.
de: Den Platz zu dokumentieren verringerte den Streit um Erinnerung.
en: Documenting my place reduced fights over memory.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_inlaw_power_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0064 and satz_c2_0066

ko: 이름 호명이 누구에게는 친밀이고 누구에게는 무례였어요.
de: Beim Namen rufen war für die einen Nähe, für die anderen Unhöflichkeit.
en: Calling by name was intimacy for some and rudeness for others.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0065 and satz_c2_0067

ko: 기억의 편집은 앨범에서 누가 잘리는지로 보였어요.
de: Der Schnitt der Erinnerung zeigte sich daran, wer im Album fehlt.
en: The editing of memory showed in who was cropped from the album.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0066 and satz_c2_0068

ko: 서사의 주인이 바뀌자 같은 방문이 다른 이야기가 됐어요.
de: Als der Herr der Erzählung wechselte, wurde derselbe Besuch eine andere Geschichte.
en: When the owner of the story changed, the same visit became another tale.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0067 and satz_c2_0069

ko: 호칭의 정치는 친근함의 가면을 쓰고 경계를 정했어요.
de: Die Politik der Anrede setzte Grenzen hinter der Maske der Nähe.
en: The politics of address set borders behind a mask of closeness.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0068 and satz_c2_0070

ko: 망각의 예절은 아픈 질문을 다시 하지 않는 일이었어요.
de: Manieren des Vergessens hießen, die schmerzende Frage nicht zu wiederholen.
en: Manners of forgetting meant not asking the painful question again.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0069 and satz_c2_0071

ko: 기록 주체가 누구인지에 따라 실수의 주인이 달라졌어요.
de: Wer aufschreibt, verschob, wem der Fehler gehörte.
en: Who writes the record changed who owned the mistake.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0070 and satz_c2_0072

ko: 호명의 거부를 무례가 아니라 자기 보호로 설명해 달라고 했어요.
de: Die Verweigerung der Benennung als Schutz, nicht als Unhöflichkeit zu lesen bat ich.
en: I asked them to read refusal of a name as protection, not rudeness.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0071 and satz_c2_0073

ko: 공동 기억을 한 장의 사진으로 고정하지 않기로 했어요.
de: Geteilte Erinnerung nicht auf ein Foto zu reduzieren vereinbarten wir.
en: We agreed not to freeze shared memory into one photo.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0072 and satz_c2_0074

ko: 말의 유산이 다음 명절의 대본이 되지 않게 메모를 고쳤어요.
de: Damit das Erbe der Worte nicht das nächste Festskript wird, änderte ich die Notiz.
en: I changed the note so the inheritance of words would not script the next holiday.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0073 and satz_c2_0075

ko: 별명 대신 이름을 되찾자고 하니 방이 잠시 멈췄어요.
de: Den Namen statt des Spitznamens zurückzuholen ließ den Raum kurz stehen.
en: Asking to reclaim a name instead of the nickname paused the room.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0074 and satz_c2_0076

ko: 기억을 재배치하자 내가 손님만은 아니게 됐어요.
de: Erinnerung neu zu ordnen machte mich zu mehr als nur Gast.
en: Rearranging memory made me more than only a guest.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0075 and satz_c2_0077

ko: 서사를 공유하자 한 사람의 농담이 모두의 역사가 되지 않았어요.
de: Die Erzählung zu teilen hinderte den Witz einer Person, aller Geschichte zu werden.
en: Sharing authorship stopped one person's joke from becoming everyone's history.
field_notes: rights: original; pack: c2_partner_name_memory_1; canonical sentence derives cloze_c2_0076 and satz_c2_0078
